en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a city square with an ornate stone drinking fountain in the foreground, decorated with sculpted lion heads and reliefs, surrounded by a circular flowerbed. In the background stands a large domed former mosque on a raised terrace, with steps leading up from the square and hills visible behind the city. The reverse side has a purple 40 fillér Hungarian stamp labeled "MAGYAR POSTA", handwritten Hungarian text, and printed publisher/location marks including "PÉCS, Széchenyi tér".
